scenes.title: Clarendon tops Jamaica's Airbnb yields: £1,396 a month from a £71k 2-bed
scenes.vo: Clarendon tops Jamaica's Airbnb yields. A typical two-bed there grosses about thirteen hundred and ninety-six pounds a month.

scenes.desc: Typical 2-bed asking price, Clarendon (about $95k US). 23.6% gross yield
scenes.vo: And it's listed at about seventy-one thousand pounds, roughly ninety-five thousand US dollars. That's a twenty-three point six percent gross yield.

scenes.desc: St Elizabeth, 2nd. Westmoreland 3rd at 15.5%. Gross, 60% occupancy
scenes.vo: St Elizabeth is second at twenty-two point one percent, and Westmoreland third at fifteen point five.
Low prices drive those yields. But they assume you're booked sixty percent of the time, and nobody can promise that occupancy.
And it's all gross, before cleaning, fees and management.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
